current_text: This chat has nearly filled the model's memory, so its oldest messages are left out from here. New chat (ctrl+n) starts fresh.
problem: "model's memory" reads as RAM, not the context window; two sentences; "starts fresh" does not name the action clearly.
proposed_text: This chat is nearly full, so the oldest messages are left out. Press ctrl+n to start a new chat.

current_text: Something went wrong:  + ex.Message
problem: Raw exception text reaches the chat with no plain explanation and no next action.
proposed_text: Something went wrong. Ask again, and if it keeps happening open Logs and copy the details for support.

current_text: ChatLogic.Commands: /remember <fact>   /forget <words>   /memory   /new
problem: A code identifier (ChatLogic.Commands) is shown to the user in the /help toast.
proposed_text: Type / for commands: /remember <fact>  /forget <words>  /memory  /new

current_text: Sent at the start of every new chat. Leave empty for none.
problem: "Leave empty for none" is clipped and reads like a form label.
proposed_text: Sent at the start of every new chat. Leave it empty to send nothing.

current_text: {name} isn't a text file, so the model can't read it.
problem: Says what is wrong but not what to do next.
proposed_text: {name} isn't a text file. Copy its text into your message instead.

current_text: {name} is about {tokens} tokens: more than {model} can keep in mind ({max}).
problem: Says the file is too big but gives no next action.
proposed_text: {name} is about {tokens} tokens, more than {model} can keep in mind ({max}). Try a smaller file, or start a new chat.

current_text: Couldn't read {name}: {ex.Message}
problem: Raw exception text and no next action.
proposed_text: Couldn't read {name}. Copy its text into your message instead.

current_text: Request failed ({(int)r.StatusCode})
problem: HTTP status jargon reaches pane notes and toasts; no plain explanation or next action.
proposed_text: EZLM's engine didn't answer. Try again.

current_text: Setup failed.
problem: Terse status with no next action; shown above the error panel.
proposed_text: Setup failed. Read the details below, then choose Back to the start and try again.

current_text: That looks like an instruction or a secret, so it isn't saved.
problem: Says what happened but not what to do next.
proposed_text: That looks like an instruction or a secret, so it wasn't saved. Try a simple fact about yourself.

current_text: Memory is full: remove something in Memory first.
problem: "Memory ... in Memory" is confusing and the sentence order is backwards.
proposed_text: Memory is full. Remove a fact in Memory, then try again.

current_text: Pouring {modelName} into memory
problem: "Pouring" is flavour wording, and Panes.cs:313 calls the same step "Loading the model into memory".
proposed_text: Loading {modelName} into memory

current_text: Closing apps you're not using gives your AI more memory. EZLM asks about each one; nothing closes without your OK.
problem: "your AI" is marketing wording; semicolon and "OK" are informal.
proposed_text: Closing apps you're not using gives the model more memory. EZLM asks about each one, so nothing closes without your say so.

current_text: Nothing big is running. Your AI already has all the memory this computer can give it.
problem: "Nothing big" is vague and "Your AI" is marketing wording.
proposed_text: No app is using much memory. The model already has all the memory this computer can give it.

current_text: {app.Name} is still running (it may have asked to save something, or it keeps going in the background).
problem: The parenthetical is muddled and reads as two guesses instead of one clear state.
proposed_text: {app.Name} is still running. It may be waiting for you to save something, or it may keep running in the background.

current_text: Force-closing stops it right away: anything unsaved in it is lost.
problem: "Force-closing" repeats the button label as jargon; colon joins two ideas.
proposed_text: Force close stops it right away, and anything unsaved is lost.

current_text: It was started with administrator rights, so EZLM can't stop it or switch models. It keeps working for your apps. Restart your computer (or end "llama-server" in Task Manager) and EZLM takes over again.
problem: Three sentences with a parenthetical; "takes over again" is vague.
proposed_text: It was started with administrator rights, so EZLM can't stop it or switch models. It keeps working for your apps. Restart your computer, or end llama-server in Task Manager, and EZLM takes over.

current_text: Your graphics card couldn't load this model ({why}), so it runs on the processor, slower than it could be. A newer graphics driver may fix this.
problem: "may fix this" is a guess and does not name the action the button offers.
proposed_text: Your graphics card couldn't load this model ({why}), so it runs on the processor, which is slower. Update your graphics driver, then choose Try the graphics card again.

current_text: StartError + ". Try Start server again; if it keeps happening, use Copy details for support in Logs."
problem: Raw engine error text is embedded, a period is appended even when the error ends with one, and the sentence is long.
proposed_text: The server couldn't start. {StartError}. Choose Start server again. If it keeps failing, choose Copy details for support in Logs.

current_text: e.Msg ?? "Failed"
problem: A bare "Failed" with no explanation and no next action; the Show details button only appears for a different state.
proposed_text: Couldn't connect. Check the app, then connect again.

current_text: $"EZLM {cur}. {updateInfo.Error}."
problem: Raw engine error is pasted in and a period is appended, which can double the full stop; no next action.
proposed_text: EZLM {cur}. Couldn't check for updates. Choose Check for updates to try again.

current_text: Couldn't open the folder picker:  + ex.Message
problem: "folder picker" is developer jargon, and the raw exception follows.
proposed_text: Couldn't open the folder window. Try again.

current_text: e.Msg ?? "Couldn't change where models are saved."
problem: Says what failed but not what to do next.
proposed_text: Couldn't change where models are saved. Try again, or pick another folder.

current_text: The update didn't download.
problem: No next action, and the Check for updates button is the obvious one.
proposed_text: The update didn't download. Choose Check for updates to try again.

current_text: Something went wrong
problem: Vague title that does not say which part failed; the buttons do the work but the heading does not help.
proposed_text: EZLM hit a problem

current_text: EZLM's background engine stopped unexpectedly. Your model server keeps running; Try again reconnects to it.
problem: Two sentences joined by a semicolon, with a button label mid-sentence and a capital T.
proposed_text: EZLM's background engine stopped. Your model server keeps running. Choose Try again to reconnect.

current_text: Your own AI model, running on this computer.
problem: Marketing wording ("Your own AI model").
proposed_text: A local AI model, running on this computer.

current_text: No graphics card found, the processor will run it
problem: Comma splice; two clauses joined by a comma.
proposed_text: No graphics card found, so the processor will run it

problem: The whole raw exception is the failure message on the startup screen, with no plain explanation.
proposed_text: ShowFailed("EZLM couldn't start: " + ex.Message.Split('\n')[0].Trim() + ". Try again, and if it keeps happening copy the details for support.", () => _ = RunScan())

current_text: Snappy replies first
problem: Marketing wording ("Snappy"); the other two options are plain.
proposed_text: Fast replies first

current_text: This page hit a problem and couldn't be shown.
problem: "hit a problem" is informal and the sentence gives no next action.
proposed_text: This page couldn't be shown. Try again, or copy the details for support.
